# GENERATED -- do not edit by hand.
#
#   echo "ghunt==2.3.4" > requirements.in
#   uv pip compile --generate-hashes --no-header --python-version 3.13 \
#       requirements.in -o requirements.txt
#
# uv rather than pip-compile: --generate-hashes downloads every platform wheel
# of every pin to hash it (scipy, numpy and pillow alone are ~300 wheels, over
# a GB), and pip-compile does that serially. It timed out against PyPI here
# after ~50 minutes; uv parallelises and finished in 2 seconds. The output
# format is identical -- all platform hashes, no environment markers -- so the
# lock stays valid for amd64 CI even though it was generated on arm64.
#
# --require-hashes lives here rather than in dh_virtualenv's --extra-pip-arg
# because that flag is also applied to the venv bootstrap (pip, setuptools,
# wheel), which is unpinned by nature and fails hash-checking mode.
--require-hashes
